description: Paid ($0.005): Parses a statement and exports it as normalized CSV, an hledger journal, a SIE4 file (experimental) or JSON. The converted file is returned as a string in the content field. JSON body up to 1000 KB. Failed calls (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Without a payment header the result is the x402 payment requirements.

bankAccount.description: Bank account number (SIE4, e.g. 1930) or ledger account (hledger).

columns.description: CSV: map field names (date, amount, description, ...) to exact header names.

company.description: Company name for the SIE4 header.

content.description: The statement file as text (UTF-8). PDF and scanned images are not supported.

currency.description: Fallback ISO 4217 currency when the file has none, e.g. SEK.

dateFormat.description: CSV date order override for ambiguous dates.

delimiter.description: CSV delimiter override: comma, semicolon, tab or pipe.

includeRaw.description: Add the raw source fields to every transaction.

name: convert_statement
